skala_empty_block_style #

How an empty block's braces are laid out. ⚠ Measured 2026-08-30: the three values are genuinely distinct, and the two togethers differ only once the brace would be on its own line — under csharp_new_line_before_open_brace = all, together gives void M() / { } and together_same_line gives void M() { }, pulling the pair back onto the declaration's line against the placement key. Under the export's none they are the same bytes. Skala read together_same_line as multiline and split the pair. ⚠ together_same_line's second half — overriding the placement key — is not implemented, because it needs the brace-split direction Skala does not have. SK-DIV-0091.

skala_use_continuous_indent_inside_initializer_braces #

Whether an initializer's contents take a continuation level. ⚠ Measured 2026-08-30 at skala_continuous_indent_multiplier = 2: a new List<int> { at column 12 puts its elements on 20 at true and on 16 at false, so false is one indent width rather than none. Under the export's multiplier of 1 the two coincide. ⚠ At true the contents take skala_continuous_indent_multiplier widths — a block scope flagged IndentFlags.Multiplied, absolute as before, so nothing moves at the export's multiplier of 1 — and a switch expression's arms follow this key too: 16 at true and 12 at false from a statement at 8, measured at multipliers 2 and 3 (#464). SK-DIV-0090.
